package http

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

const onboardingDraftStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

type onboardingDraftHTTPStub struct {
	studentID      string
	putInput       studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput
	finalizeInputs []studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput
	completed      bool
	finalizeKey    string
	finalizeResult domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult
}

func (stub *onboardingDraftHTTPStub) get(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	stub.studentID = studentID
	return domain.EmptyStudentOnboardingDraft(studentID)
}

func (stub *onboardingDraftHTTPStub) put(
	_ context.Context,
	input studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	stub.studentID, stub.putInput = input.StudentID, input
	if input.RequestID == "" || input.Schema != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if stub.completed {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	return domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: input.StudentID,
		Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: input.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers,
		Version: input.ExpectedVersion + 1, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now,
	})
}

func (stub *onboardingDraftHTTPStub) finalize(
	_ context.Context,
	input studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, error) {
	stub.studentID = input.StudentID
	stub.finalizeInputs = append(stub.finalizeInputs, input)
	if input.RequestID == "" || input.Schema != domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeCommandSchema {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if stub.completed {
		if input.RequestID == stub.finalizeKey {
			return stub.finalizeResult, nil
		}
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	profileVersion := int64(1)
	result, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingFinalizeResult(domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResultSchema,
		Draft: domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
			Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: input.StudentID,
			Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted, Version: input.ExpectedDraftVersion + 1,
			CompletedProfileVersion: &profileVersion, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now, CompletedAt: &now,
		},
		Profile: domain.StudentOnboarding{
			StudentID: input.StudentID, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic",
			KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "first-job",
			PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 300, PreferredPace: "balanced",
			ProfileVersion: domain.StudentOnboardingProfileVersion, Version: profileVersion,
			CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{}, err
	}
	stub.completed, stub.finalizeKey, stub.finalizeResult = true, input.RequestID, result
	return result, nil
}

type onboardingDraftGetterFunc func(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error)

func (function onboardingDraftGetterFunc) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	return function(ctx, studentID)
}

type onboardingDraftPutterFunc func(context.Context, studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error)

func (function onboardingDraftPutterFunc) Handle(ctx context.Context, input studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	return function(ctx, input)
}

type onboardingDraftFinalizerFunc func(context.Context, studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, error)

func (function onboardingDraftFinalizerFunc) Handle(ctx context.Context, input studentuc.FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, error) {
	return function(ctx, input)
}

func onboardingDraftRouter(stub *onboardingDraftHTTPStub) http.Handler {
	return NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler: &handlers.AnswerHandler{},
		StudentOnboardingHandler: &handlers.StudentOnboardingHandler{
			GetDraft: onboardingDraftGetterFunc(stub.get), PutDraft: onboardingDraftPutterFunc(stub.put),
			FinalizeDraft: onboardingDraftFinalizerFunc(stub.finalize),
		},
	})
}

func onboardingDraftRequest(method, target, body, requestID string) *http.Request {
	request := httptest.NewRequest(method, target, strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", onboardingDraftStudentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	if requestID != "" {
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", requestID)
	}
	return request
}

func TestStudentOnboardingDraftRoutesUseTrustedIdentityAndPreservePartialShape(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &onboardingDraftHTTPStub{}
	router := onboardingDraftRouter(stub)

	getResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(getResponse, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", "", ""))
	if getResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || stub.studentID != onboardingDraftStudentID ||
		!strings.Contains(getResponse.Body.String(), `"status":"DRAFT","version":0`) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected empty draft response: status=%d student=%q body=%s", getResponse.Code, stub.studentID, getResponse.Body.String())
	}

	requestID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	putResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(putResponse, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPut, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", `{
		"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":0,
		"goal_text":"","known_stacks":[],"weekly_minutes":300
	}`, requestID))
	if putResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || stub.putInput.StudentID != onboardingDraftStudentID ||
		stub.putInput.RequestID != requestID || stub.putInput.GoalText == nil || *stub.putInput.GoalText != "" ||
		stub.putInput.KnownStacks == nil || len(*stub.putInput.KnownStacks) != 0 || stub.putInput.DirectionCode != nil {
		t.Fatalf("trusted identity or answered/unanswered shape lost: status=%d input=%+v body=%s", putResponse.Code, stub.putInput, putResponse.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestStudentOnboardingDraftHTTPFinalizeReplayAndCompletedConflicts(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &onboardingDraftHTTPStub{}
	router := onboardingDraftRouter(stub)
	finalizeKey := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	body := `{"schema":"student-onboarding-finalize.v1","expected_draft_version":1,"expected_profile_version":0}`

	first := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(first, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft/finalize", body, finalizeKey))
	replay := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(replay, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft/finalize", body, finalizeKey))
	if first.Code != http.StatusOK || replay.Code != http.StatusOK || first.Body.String() != replay.Body.String() {
		t.Fatalf("finalize replay did not return original result: first=%d %s replay=%d %s", first.Code, first.Body.String(), replay.Code, replay.Body.String())
	}
	var decoded domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(replay.Body.Bytes(), &decoded); err != nil || decoded.Draft.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusCompleted ||
		decoded.Draft.DirectionCode != nil || decoded.Profile.Version != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid replay envelope: err=%v result=%+v", err, decoded)
	}

	differentKey := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(differentKey, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft/finalize", body, "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"))
	putAfterCompletion := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(putAfterCompletion, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPut, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", `{
		"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":2,"goal_text":"changed"
	}`, "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"))
	if differentKey.Code != http.StatusConflict || putAfterCompletion.Code != http.StatusConflict {
		t.Fatalf("completed draft accepted another command: finalize=%d put=%d", differentKey.Code, putAfterCompletion.Code)
	}
}

func TestStudentOnboardingDraftHTTPRejectsUnknownOversizeAndUntrustedActor(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &onboardingDraftHTTPStub{}
	router := onboardingDraftRouter(stub)
	requestID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"

	unknown := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unknown, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPut, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", `{
		"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":0,"student_id":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	}`, requestID))
	oversize := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(oversize, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPut, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", `{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":0,"goal_text":"`+strings.Repeat("x", 17<<10)+`"}`, requestID))
	missingKey := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(missingKey, onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodPut, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", `{
		"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","expected_version":0,"goal_text":""
	}`, ""))
	wrongRole := onboardingDraftRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", "", "")
	wrongRole.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "TEACHER")
	forbidden := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(forbidden, wrongRole)
	unauthorized := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unauthorized, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/student/onboarding/draft", nil))
	if unknown.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || oversize.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || missingKey.Code != http.StatusBadRequest ||
		forbidden.Code != http.StatusForbidden || unauthorized.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf("strict/auth statuses: unknown=%d oversize=%d missingKey=%d forbidden=%d unauthorized=%d",
			unknown.Code, oversize.Code, missingKey.Code, forbidden.Code, unauthorized.Code)
	}
}
